regression_status: NOT_ALL_GREEN; see raw per-run outcomes, not a fabricated merged total
regression_notes: Full regression first run: 538 pass, 12 fail, 50 skip, 1 collection error. It predates the CLI checkout-import fix.
CLI was importing another editable worktree. Fixed by placing current checkout src/root first on sys.path.
Targeted rerun after CLI fix: 4 pass, 2 fail. The two failures are native synthetic padded-GT autoscaling to 1.00000006, reproduced in the base checkout.
Seven other failures plus the collection error were independently reproduced in the unchanged base bb48650 checkout.

Baseline categories: notebook CRLF snapshot mismatch, Windows mmap resume unlink, native fixture nonbinary labels, preexisting documentation language/link/entry checks, missing tools.order_optimization_pilot at collection.
Native512 implementation, strict binary-mask validation, old notebook snapshots and legacy resume behavior were not modified to hide these failures.
No full-suite green claim; no actual 199-volume training or validation quality run.
remaining_limits: Run full read-only --hash-files --voxels preflight on mounted real tiles before training.
Run one io-smoke with exact production config on recipient CUDA hardware.
Same source/mount/path/timestamps are required for resume; changing mount needs a separately verified rebinding protocol, not implemented.
Compressed tile reads may be slow under original volume shuffle with one tile cache; no performance claim.
Whole-slice presence/calibration and raw external Zenodo protocol are intentionally unsupported for this tile adapter.
Existing repository regression failures remain documented separately from passing B3B tests.
time_policy: Each test-run XML records actual wall duration; do not sum overlapping/repeated runs as unique elapsed project time.
